intro: Opulent elevates your everyday dining. With glass-topped elegance paired with warm tones and solid wood strength, it is a truly inviting dining experience.

features.title: Tempered glass elegance
features.text: A white-tempered glass top with a subtle beige tint gives your dining space a clean, luxurious look while resisting scratches and stains with ease.

features.title: Solid wood understructure
features.text: Crafted with a sheesham wood frame and oak wood legs, this table offers dependable strength and long-lasting durability in a stylish silhouette.

features.title: Generous seating for six
features.text: Designed with family and gatherings in mind, its spacious surface comfortably accommodates six people—perfect for everyday meals or festive occasions.

features.title: Worry-free upkeep
features.text: Glass top is easy to wipe clean after meals, so your table always looks polished without extra effort—ideal for busy, elegant homes.

features.title: Subtle, versatile finish
features.text: The beige top and walnut-shade legs create a beautiful contrast, easily blending with light or dark interiors for a timeless visual harmony.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Opulent V2 6-Seater Wooden Rectangular Dining Table
